description: Na₆Mg(CoO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.81 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.47 Å. Mg is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.03 Å) and two longer (2.05 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. Co is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.96 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom.
